description: Leaves one of your companies; your access ends immediately and you need a new invitation to return. The last owner cannot leave: make someone else an owner first. Call without confirm first for a preview, then again with confirm and the preview_token.

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

name: company_leave
title: Leave a company
